provenance.prompt:
Keep exact Echo Catwalk identity from reference: ADULT MAN, medium-brown skin, visibly masculine face, short spiky dark-teal curls, teal headband, strong recognizable trimmed dark-teal beard and mustache, compact athletic body, teal uniform with dark-purple trim, black knee pads, teal-black shoes and wristbands. Never female or long-haired. Create a strict row-major 5x3 sheet of exactly fifteen complete full-body figures in transparent RGBA at 1536x1024, original art right-facing. Crisp outlined 1990s arcade pixel sprites; no backgrounds, courts, hoop, shadows, text, effects, opponents, props or basketball. Keep all bodies distinct and inside their cells.

This is a true 360-degree dunk spin. Use each pose’s torso facing direction as the main visual cue; rotate gradually and visibly. Sequence: 0 running right in profile; 1 gathers right-facing; 2 jumps, still right-facing; 3 turns three-quarter away; 4 clearly back-facing, jersey back visible; 5 back-facing; 6 rotates to left-facing profile; 7 left-facing profile, face/profile visible; 8 turns three-quarter toward viewer; 9 clearly front-facing, chest visible; 10 rotates to three-quarter right; 11 returns to right-facing profile and reaches empty hand high to dunk; 12 empty-hand follow-through; 13 descending right-facing; 14 lands and returns ready right-facing. The changing orientation must show one continuous complete full revolution, not a half-turn. Maintain the same connected anatomy and outfit from pose to pose, with exactly two arms and legs. No basketball at any point: ball is a separate Echo-specific runtime track. Transparent alpha-zero gutters and background, no checkerboard or haze. Return only the sprite sheet.

review.notes: Accepted 15-pose source preserves Echo’s masculine identity, beard, hair, headband, body and uniform. Orientation changes visibly from side through back and front, returning to right-facing on landing; independent anatomy and scale retained. No embedded ball. First generation was rejected because pose sequence showed only about half a turn.

ballTrack.art: none; independent athlete-specific runtime ball path
ballTrack.notes: Never merge this ball with another athlete’s track; runtime ball release/action timing is independent of atlas.

cleanup.method: Retain largest alpha>=32 component plus 2px fringe inside every 5x3 cell, then isolated pose packing.

generationHistory.reason: Pose sequence did not show the requested full 360-degree rotation; orientation returned only about halfway.
